name: reto-metas
description: App de seguimiento de metas para retos de habitos de 30 dias

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace web && npm run dev --workspace api
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.cf:migrar: wrangler d1 migrations apply reto-metas --remote --config api/wrangler.toml
